info.title: Talvio LLM service
info.description: Async AI operations for Talvio. Generated from @talvio/llm-contracts; do not edit by hand. Browsers call the same-origin /api/llm adapter, which forwards the Supabase access token.

post.summary: Register an upload and get a short-lived private upload grant.

delete.summary: Revoke access, cancel dependent work and schedule cleanup.

post.summary: Pin the uploaded object and start validation. Runs no OCR or model.
Idempotent; a terminal job is returned unchanged.
Retry a retryable failure within the original deadline and budget.

supabaseJwt.description: Supabase access token of a signed-in, non-anonymous user.
